A '''self-sharpening sheath'''<ref name="SWS" /> or '''auto-sharpening sheath'''<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> was a [[Sheath/Legends|sheath]] to store bladed weapons, and allow them to be sharpened while holstered. Combat [[Knife/Legends|knives]], [[Hatchet (weapon)|hatchets]], and [[Bayonet/Legends|bayonets]] could all be stored in self-sharpening sheaths.<ref name="SWS" />
